heroBody: A Computer Science student and Full-Stack Developer passionate about engineering impactful digital experiences. I build modern, scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js — combining thoughtful design with robust engineering to turn ideas into powerful digital products.
aboutBody: I’m Mohamed Ayman, a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science student passionate about engineering robust, scalable, and well-structured web applications.
aboutBody2: My work spans the full development lifecycle, from crafting responsive, high-quality interfaces with React and Next.js to building secure, efficient backend systems with Node.js and Express.js. I focus on delivering seamless user experiences backed by reliable architecture and production-ready code.
aboutBody3: Beyond implementation, I’m interested in software architecture, problem-solving, and the decisions that shape great products. I strive to turn complex ideas into practical, well-engineered solutions that balance functionality, performance, and long-term scalability.

projectsIntro: A showcase of projects built with purpose, combining thoughtful design, solid engineering, and real-world problem-solving.

project-01.name: Booking Platform
project-01.description: A full-stack accommodation booking platform with property management, reservations, and role-based experiences for guests, hosts, and administrators. It includes JWT authentication, Google OAuth, reviews, and Stripe payments, with MongoDB, Cloudinary, and TanStack Query supporting the experience.

project-02.name: Craveo
project-02.description: A multi-role food ordering platform for customers, administrators, and delivery teams. It brings together product customization, cart management, order tracking, and Stripe payments, powered by a Node.js and Express.js API with PostgreSQL and Prisma.
